scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@soldy-ui/core && npm run build --workspace=@soldy-ui/plugins && npm run build --workspace=@soldy-ui/setup && npm run build --workspace=@soldy-ui/icons-material && npm run build --workspace=@soldy-ui/icons-lucide && npm run build --workspace=@soldy-ui/theme-oren && npm run build --workspace=@soldy-ui/vue && npm run build --workspace=@soldy-ui/react && npm run build --workspace=@soldy-ui/solid && npm run build --workspace=@soldy-ui/webc && npm run build --workspace=@soldy-ui/svelte && npm run build --workspace=@soldy-ui/angular
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n theme,playground -c blue,green "npm run watch:theme" "npm run dev --workspace=@soldy-ui/playground-vue"
scripts.test:theme: npm run test --workspace=@soldy-ui/theme-base && npm run test --workspace=@soldy-ui/theme-oren
scripts.test:playground: npm run test --workspace=@soldy-ui/playground-shared && npm run test --workspace=@soldy-ui/playground-vue
scripts.test:layout: npm run build:css --workspace=@soldy-ui/theme-oren && npm run test:browser --workspace=@soldy-ui/playground-vue
